author: Cezbla
body:
This is a new gamemode that I think should be added...


It is a 2 team game and each team has its own spawn or what ever it has a king as well... the king is chosen once the game starts he is locked in a 3 layer obsidian block he starts with full prot 1 diamond armor stone pick unbreaking 1000 so he can break him self out, his sword is sharpness 2 fire aspect 2 and the goal of the game is too kill him... so here is the over look

You will be able too make it shorter amount of obsidian if the mapdev's agree with it.. 

You will be able too just go around your base if you are the king you cannot go out. [Coding should stop the king] 

If you are a diamond you can choose too be the king if there are 2 diamonds and they already are king you are in a line waiting.

You will be able too change the armor of what the King has based on what the player's have [Player's have full diamond prot 1 sharpness 3, king has prot 4 fire 4 knockback 2]

I think this game mode would be awesome!!! I will be making a map for it just so you can see what I mean by the game mode.

Last over see here it is again

The game has 2 team's you are either on one or another [Ofc] someone gets tped right in the tomb of the king in where they can break there way out [With a wood or stone pick] or wait in there until people attack him, once killed the game ends and the team that killed the king wins, 

This is a good game-mode because it brings a lot of pvp together but still kinda like monument getting

Another way this could work...

You put a zombie or a mob in a obsidian cover 1 layer... it is armed with OP OP OP armor.... thats the king so the rushing is a bit easier and rusher's still can do there thing.


I think the mob is better but! your choice tell me what you think thanks byee
